verified_facts: The official ORCCA page identifies the textbook and its contents as licensed under CC BY 4.0.
Redistribution requires the attribution text supplied by Portland Community College.
Redistributed mathematical content must remain readable and be offered in at least one web-accessible form.
PCC and ORCCA names, logos, and print cover designs are excluded from the Creative Commons license.
The official page publishes odd-numbered answers for edition 2 and states that even-numbered answers are not published.
selected_scope: Edition 2 odd-numbered public algebra exercises and project-derived deterministic solutions only.
